божество переносит тебя\nВидимые выходы:.en:
a deity transports you
Visible exits: none
you look around
The Prison of the Dreamland
Walls of cold, damp, mouldy stone... Not a single window...
A floor fouled beyond words... Filth everywhere, and rats scurrying about. Where would they even come from?
Not a crack to be seen anywhere, not one a cockroach could squeeze through...
There is not even a door! The whole furnishing is a bunk knocked together out
of rotten wood, a barrel of stagnant water, and a crate of bread green with
mould. You find yourself wondering: where do the water and the bread come from?
You are in the area Limbo. Nearby you:
Nobody.
misery and hopelessness.

You dream of the sea...
A warm, summer sea...
Early morning. The sun has only just begun to tint the sky pink...
A morning mist lies over the water...
Out of the mist, far off, you hear a voice...
It is a song. But it sounds a long way away and you cannot make out the words...
The sounds come closer...
A frigate appears out of the mist...
On the bridge you see a half-elven captain...
At the wheel, an elven helmsman...
But what is that on the mast, right above the sails?!
On the top stands a satyr in nothing but a striped sailor's shirt...
In one hand he has an iron flask, with the other he hugs the mast...
A little tail sticks out from under the shirt...
Swinging the flask from side to side, the goat-legged one bawls out a song in a dreadful voice...
Now you can hear the words clearly...
Hear them, but not understand them. Perhaps the song is in Satyr...

{cBeside them you see a young witch in an Archmage's robe, listening warily to the talk.{x
{cThe Entities have no need of words, and meanings arise in your head of their own accord.{x
{B- Epistemologically, Good and Evil have become useless in the context of the transgression of the Paths.{x
{D- And there is hardly a mind left that can follow your droning, Blue-Eyes.{x
{B- Binary determinism is obsolete. Only the reasoning are free. The free are reasoning.{x
{D- Arbeit macht frei. Fine, masks off, we shall play with the light directly now.{x
{D...Into the blue and the booze, heh. But then your little hooks will want tightening too.{x
{B- The Algorithms of Creation, called "magic" in the boiled world, are transforming into{x
{B...supple instruments of epistemology. The reasoning will be able to create the New.{x
{cThe clot of Darkness goes still for a moment, then flows smoothly over to the young witch.{x
{D- Hey, you. Sharp-ears. Yes, you. Fancy making it a threesome with Reason?{x
{cThe witch nods, dryly and with dignity.{x
